challenges.eyebrow: Everyday home care in the UK
challenges.title: Travel time, the National Living Wage and record-keeping duties

items.title: Travel time between clients counts as working time
items.text: Under established HMRC practice, travel between clients during a working day counts as paid working time, so the effective hourly rate doesn't fall below the National Living Wage — only the first outbound journey and the last journey home are excluded.

items.title: The National Living Wage keeps rising
items.text: Since 1 April 2026, the National Living Wage has been £12.71 an hour — up from £12.21 since April 2025. Rotas and payroll runs must keep these rates in sync, or back payments become a risk.

items.title: Risk of HMRC sanctions for underpayment
items.text: Breaches of the National Living Wage can be penalised with arrears repayments of up to 200% plus public naming-and-shaming by HMRC — capped at £20,000 per worker.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off home care in the UK
solutions.subtitle: From travel time as working time to the time basis for payroll — everything works together.

items.title: Rounds automatically optimised
items.text: Klacks plans visit routes so that journeys stay short and time windows are met — by car, bike or on foot.

items.title: Travel time stored as working time
items.text: A fixed travel-time value can be stored for each shift and counts as working time — Klacks does not calculate the actual journey times between clients individually.

items.title: Time basis for the National Living Wage
items.text: Klacks provides the hours worked, including the travel-time value, for your payroll — you carry out the comparison against the National Living Wage of £12.71 an hour in your payroll software.

items.title: Qualifications factored in automatically
items.text: Every visit is only assigned to staff with the matching qualification — with no manual checking at all. If a required qualification is missing or has expired, Klacks refuses the assignment, in manual planning too.

items.title: Installed on your premises: data stored on your servers
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure. Patient data is stored on your servers — and with a locally hosted AI model, no AI request goes to an external AI provider.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: "Fill the rounds for tomorrow" is all it takes. If someone calls in sick, Klacksy immediately suggests available cover.

example.title: Travel time, the Living Wage, one plan
example.text: Klacks counts the stored travel-time value per shift as working time and provides the hours as a time basis for the National Living Wage — no manual recalculating required.
